hard_rules: Source registry membership is not proof of acquisition.
Every network attempt produces a source_attempt receipt.
Raw snapshots are hashed and retained when public retrieval succeeds.
A proxy never closes a direct-data gap.
No credentials or API keys are stored in source tree.
